title: Phase Shift Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly relate the phase shift delta to the solution of the Schrödinger equation.

title: Differential Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The formula for the differential scattering cross section must be accurately provided in terms of delta and k.

title: No Scattering Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of how a purely attractive potential can lead to no scattering must be clear and include a relevant diagram.

title: Resonance Scattering Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of resonance scattering due to a potential that is attractive at short distances and repulsive at large distances must be clear and include a relevant diagram.

title: Total Cross Section Value
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum value of the total cross section at the center of the resonance must be correctly stated.

title: Phase Shift Conditions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid errors in stating conditions under which delta leads to no scattering, such as incorrect phase shift values.

title: Dimensional Reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: The use of dimensional reasoning to derive the differential cross section formula is encouraged but not required.
